text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- "Terrorists" kill four people and kidnap six girls, aged 13 to 28 years, all from one family in an attack south of Algiers on Wednesday night.
- Union of Algiers won Algeria soccer cup.
- Eleven foreign ministers from the Mediterranean area to meet in Algiers on July 11-12 to discuss cooperation and security.
- Labour union of bank and insurance workers threaten to strike on Tuesday over wage rise unless employers meet their demands.
- Algeria's envoy to the United Nations in Geneva urged creditors to ease his country's foreign debt burden.
